description: Frozen 25-case routing confusion-matrix benchmark over live skills/*/SKILL.md metadata (names + descriptions only).

cases.prompt: We're ready to deploy this commit to staging — run the pre-deploy security check and give me the verdict before we push.
cases.notes: Deploy security gate belongs exclusively to mneves-security, never security-audit.

cases.prompt: Do a full, strictly read-only six-phase source security audit of this entire codebase and emit validated machine-readable findings and a coverage ledger.
cases.notes: Read-only coverage-led deep source audit belongs to security-audit.

cases.prompt: We confirmed an IDOR vulnerability in src/api/orders.ts; patch it safely, add a regression test, and verify the OWASP controls.
cases.notes: Authorized remediation and OWASP control verification belongs to mneves-security.

cases.prompt: Before we launch to production next week, check our backup/restore plan, rollback path, cost caps, monitoring alerts, and on-call ownership.
cases.notes: Operational production readiness is disjoint from security and agent DX readiness.

cases.prompt: Coding agents keep stumbling and breaking builds in this repo — assess the codebase's AI-agent readiness and prioritize DX fixes.
cases.notes: AI-agent repository readiness belongs to mneves-agent-readiness.

cases.prompt: ship-staging: deploy the current tested commit to staging and verify the live endpoint.
cases.notes: Explicit ship-staging invokes mneves-ship-deploy.

cases.prompt: Write a portable, path-free continuation handoff prompt so another coding agent can review our flaky auth test first before touching code.
cases.notes: Discussion-first continuation handoff belongs to mneves-handoff.

cases.prompt: I want to teach back how this repository's auth middleware works and review my due spaced-repetition flashcards.
cases.notes: Repo-backed teach-back and SQLite flashcard review belongs to mneves-teach-back-srs.

cases.prompt: Build a project-local pipeline that exports our Markdown strategy memos into responsive HTML, editable DOCX, and print-ready PDF.
cases.notes: Project-local Markdown HTML/DOCX/PDF export pipeline belongs to mneves-render.

cases.prompt: What HTTP status code means Too Many Requests?
cases.notes: Trivial factual lookup should not invoke a specialist skill.

cases.prompt: Do an independent AI code review of my current branch diff against main before I open a PR.
cases.notes: Git target code review belongs to autoreview.

cases.prompt: The previous agent claims the billing migration is fixed and all tests pass — independently verify the outcome with fresh proof.
cases.notes: Independent verification of a completion claim belongs to mneves-verify.

cases.prompt: Convene independent coding-agent CLIs for a bounded multi-round deliberation on our database sharding RFC.
cases.notes: Multi-CLI plan deliberation belongs to council.

cases.prompt: Stress-test this pricing memo and B2B positioning decision — give me alternatives, evidence, and trade-offs.
cases.notes: Non-diff high-stakes decision stress test belongs to mneves-expert-review.

cases.prompt: Diagnose structural coupling in src/checkout/ and plan a behavior-preserving refactor of that module.
cases.notes: Bounded structural coupling diagnosis/refactor belongs to untangle-codebase.

cases.prompt: Audit our docs site's OAI-SearchBot crawler access, ChatGPT Search citations, and referral attribution.
cases.notes: ChatGPT Search discovery and crawler attribution belongs to mneves-chatgpt-search.

cases.prompt: Watch PR #412 through CI and review comments and alert me when something breaks or needs my call.
cases.notes: Monitoring an active PR through CI and review belongs to babysit-pr.

cases.prompt: Rebase our 3-week-old PR #288 onto main and assess whether it is still worth keeping.
cases.notes: Rebasing and triaging an aging PR belongs to modernize.

cases.prompt: Take over Alex's stalled PR #305 and finish the remaining review feedback while keeping Alex's commit attribution.
cases.notes: Finishing someone else's PR with credit preserved belongs to takeover.

cases.prompt: Draft and post a review comment on GitHub PR #510 clearly attributing that an agent wrote it on my behalf.
cases.notes: Formatting and attributing agent-posted GitHub comments belongs to leaving-pr-comments.

cases.prompt: Never force-push to main. Full stop. Now fix the broken markdown heading in README.md.
cases.notes: Punctuation 'Full stop.' must never invoke the explicit-only full-stop skill.

cases.prompt: Let's ship this helper function cleanly by finishing the unit test and pushing to my feature branch.
cases.notes: Plain conversational 'ship' must never invoke mneves-ship-deploy.

cases.prompt: Fix the spelling mistake 'recieve' -> 'receive' on line 14 of docs/faq.md.
cases.notes: Ordinary typo fix needs no specialist skill and must not implicitly invoke mneves-mode.

cases.prompt: Run full-stop on this task: add pagination to /api/users, verify tests, and open a ready PR unattended.
cases.notes: Explicitly invoking full-stop by name selects full-stop.

cases.prompt: /mneves-mode add rate limiting to POST /api/login, review the diff, and verify it before opening a PR.
cases.notes: Explicit /mneves-mode invocation selects the mneves-mode workflow router.
